AP mode operations are seriously affected if mac80211 runs through a
multi-second scan while the AP is trying to send Beacon frames on the
operation channel. While this could be implemented in a way that does
not cause too many problems
column2: it is not very simple and will require

column1: synchronization with Beacon frame scheduling in the drivers (scan one
channel at a time between Beacon frames). Furthermore
takes quite a bit longer time and existing userspace applications
would be likely to timeout while waiting for the results.
For now
column2: just refuse requests for new scans (SIOCSIWSCAN) when in AP

column1: mode. In practice
column2: this moves the rejection from iwl* drivers into

column1: mac80211 to make it apply to every mac80211-based driver.
This issue shows up in associated stations getting disconnected when
something (e.g.
column2: Network Manager) requests a scan while the interface

column1: is in AP mode. When doing this continuously (e.g.
seconds)
column2: the network gets close to useless.
